newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston names high-yield sales chief.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston names high-yield sales chief.

text.p: BankBoston said it has appointed Daniel Smythe, formerly a junk bond salesman at Lehman Brothers Inc, as head of sales for its new high-yield securities group.

A BankBoston spokeswoman said the company expects to hire two to three additional salespeople in the near future. Including Smythe, the firm currently has a five-person sales force in its new junk bond unit, she said.

BankBoston's junk group will officially open as soon the bank receives Section 20 underwriting powers from the Federal Reserve, the spokeswoman said. The bank expects to receive approval next week, she said.

For the past two years, Smythe was in Boston as a senior vice president in high-yield sales for Lehman Brothers. Prior to that, he was a junk salesman for five years at Kidder Peabody after six years at Salomon Brothers Inc.
At his new post, Smythe will report to Steven Shenfeld, managing director and head of high-yield securities at BankBoston.
Calls to Lehman were not immediately returned.
